seo.title: Services | Wedding, Bachelorette & Event Content in Georgia
seo.description: Content for weddings, bachelorette weekends, bridal events, and celebrations in Georgia. Candid moments, curated into a story. Inquire for packages.

hero.title: Content for every celebration.
hero.body: From the first look to the last dance, from bachelorette brunch to the birthday toast, I capture the moments a camera roll would miss and curate them into a collection you'll want to watch again. Every celebration is different, so I share package details once you inquire.

extras.title: Extras
extras.body: Want a little more? These can be added on. Details come with your packages after you inquire.

steps.title: Inquire.
steps.body: Tell me about your celebration using the inquiry form. It takes just a few minutes.

steps.title: Get the details.
steps.body: I'll follow up with my availability and packages for your event.

steps.title: Plan together.
steps.body: Book an optional planning consultation so I know the moments and people that matter most.

steps.title: Capture.
steps.body: On the day, I capture it all on iPhone while you stay present with your people.

steps.title: Relive it.
steps.body: You get full access to your raw content, plus reels curated from your day.

testimonial.quote: I LOVED having you there!! I love that I have the sweetest memories in my camera roll where I didn't even realize a camera was on me. The reel that you made was literally so perfect and I loved getting to rewatch moments throughout the day because it flew by so fast! You have a great eye for little details. I'm so grateful you were there
testimonial.name: Emory Morris

goodToKnow.label: Good to know
items: Packages are shared after you inquire, so I can match options to your event.
Content creation works alongside your photographer and videographer, not instead of them.
Based in Georgia and happy to travel. Share your location when you inquire and we'll talk details.

closing.title: Have a celebration coming up?
closing.body: Let's make it one worth reliving.
